details: The Republican-led Senate Banking Committee has advanced the "Clarity Act," a landmark bill aiming to establish a comprehensive regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies. The legislation seeks to clarify regulators' jurisdiction over the sector and define whether specific tokens are classified as securities or commodities. This move is considered a significant step towards providing legal certainty for the crypto industry in the US, despite ongoing debate and lobbying efforts.
title: US Senate Committee Advances "Clarity Act" Crypto Framework

details: Financial services giant Charles Schwab has begun rolling out spot Bitcoin and Ethereum trading for selected retail clients through Schwab-linked accounts. This initiative includes 24/7 support, educational resources, research, and a 75 basis point pricing structure on trade dollar value. This development significantly expands mainstream access to major cryptocurrencies for traditional investors, enhancing liquidity and adoption.
title: Charles Schwab Rolls Out Spot Bitcoin and Ethereum Trading

details: Solana (SOL) is currently trading around $90-$93, with analysts closely watching the $98 resistance level as a key indicator for a potential breakout towards $107 and even $117. The recent Alpenglow upgrade and ongoing optimism surrounding Solana-based Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) are cited as significant factors contributing to this bullish sentiment. While experiencing slight dips and short-term bearish pressure, the continuous technical advancements, such as Alpenglow proving Solana's robust design, remain positive catalysts.
title: Solana Bulls Eye $98 Test Amid Alpenglow & ETF Optimism

details: The Ethereum Foundation has introduced a new "Clear Signing" standard (ERC-7730) designed to significantly enhance security within the ecosystem. This initiative aims to protect users by preventing them from inadvertently approving malicious crypto transactions. By providing human-readable transaction summaries across various wallets, the standard seeks to eliminate "blind signing," thereby reducing instances of phishing and deceptive prompts and bolstering user trust.
title: Ethereum Foundation Unveils New 'Clear Signing' Security Standard

details: Analysts at JPMorgan have issued a cautious outlook, suggesting that recent Ethereum upgrades may not be sufficient to significantly lift Ether's price. This perspective is attributed to weaker network activity and fading investor confidence across the altcoin market, which has kept institutional demand primarily focused on Bitcoin. The bank questions whether upcoming upgrades will be enough to revive sustained Ether demand.
title: JPMorgan Warns Ethereum Upgrades May Not Be Enough to Boost Price
